newsitem.title: USA: Cagle's Inc to fight OSHA finding, fine.
newsitem.headline: Cagle's Inc to fight OSHA finding, fine.

text.p: Cagle's Inc said Wednesday it will fight a recent finding by the U.S. Occupational Safety and Health Administration that it violated safety rules at its Macon, Georgia, processing plant.
OSHA said yesterday it would fine the Atlanta-based poultry producer $1.271 million after an employee lost a finger while cleaning moving equipment.
Cagle's said in a release Wednesday that it "strongly disputes the alleged findings by OSHA and plans to vigorously contest the proposed fine through the appropriate channels."
